text.card: A red giant 5,177 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.88 solar masses and 10.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,946 K at its surface.
